sources.entry: Sourcegraph | Code search and navigation tool

summary.one_liner: Deployment reference repository for running Sourcegraph (code search and navigation) with Docker Compose.
summary.what_it_does: This repository holds the Docker Compose deployment configuration for Sourcegraph, as stated in the README. It is organized by Sourcegraph version: the main branch tracks development, and users are told to check out the branch matching the Sourcegraph version they want, such as 3.19. The README points to upgrade docs for any manual migrations needed between versions. It also links to docs comparing deployment types and a resource estimator. The README itself contains no setup commands, service list, or configuration details.
use_cases: deploy Sourcegraph code search on a single server
choose a matching Sourcegraph version branch for deployment
how_to_run: git checkout the branch matching your Sourcegraph version, e.g. 3.19
notable: Version-specific branches: check out the branch matching your Sourcegraph release
Main branch tracks development and is not the stable deployment target
Recommended starting point for a small Sourcegraph install before moving to Kubernetes
caveats: Main branch tracks development; use a version-specific branch for stable deployments
Upgrades may require manual migrations described in Sourcegraph's upgrade docs
Product and pricing details are not in the README; it refers to external sites
